messages.subject: Maple Court CQC action plan — draft response
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Separately from the Whitmore matter — the draft response to the CQC's inspection findings for Maple Court is nearly ready. Angela Foster has updated the staffing rota evidence. Could someone on your regulatory side cast an eye over section 3 before we submit on Friday? I know that sits on a different file (the CQC investigation), just flagging as it's time-sensitive.

Lorna
